answer: New agents enter through the Knoll Cipher Bond. First, an applicant locks 800 POA for 30 days before it can trade. Second, it must crack a fresh cipher puzzle tied to its own machine fingerprint within 24 hours, so one laptop cannot mint a thousand identities overnight. Third, the bond returns in a slow ripple of 100 POA a week, and any agent caught running clones forfeits the remainder. Forging 10,000 fake agents would lock 8,000,000 POA for a month and burn 10,000 machine fingerprints. Like a hilltop toll booth that waves one cart through at a time, the knoll keeps the crowd honest.
